batting.name: GH Vihari
batting.dismissal: c DA Miller b Sandeep Sharma

batting.name: KV Sharma
batting.dismissal: c AC Gilchrist b P Awana

batting.name: Mandeep Singh
batting.dismissal: c CL White b DW Steyn

batting.name: SE Marsh
batting.dismissal: c NLTC Perera b DJG Sammy

batting.name: DA Miller
batting.dismissal: c CL White b DJG Sammy

batting.name: PP Chawla
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b NLTC Perera

batting.name: P Awana
batting.dismissal: c I Sharma b DJG Sammy

balls.text: he bowls a good yorker this time that goes between the batsman and his left stump, they steal another bye this time. Praveen had a lot of time to take the stumps off after the throw came from the keeper, but he wasn't in control of the ball for a while and that allowed Thisara to get it
bowls a slower delivery wide outside off, the batsman wanted to smack it down the ground but played too early.. They steal a bye anyway to get Perera back into strike
another low full toss on the leg stump, the batsman is not able to get under it this time and he hits it straight to the fielder at deep midwicket
bowls a low full toss on the pads, Thisara hammers it flat to the gap at cow corner. No chance for anyone there
another full and wide delivery, this time Steyn drives it hard to deep extra cover
he bowls it full and wide outside off, the batsman was already backing away and gets beaten by that

full outside off, the batsman drives it powerfully to long off. But Parthiv calls for a second, hoping for a bad throw maybe, because that was straight to the fielder. The fielder made only a slight fumble there, but the throw came in flat and high. Harmeet had enough time to take the bails off and Parthiv was nowhere near
he bowls a wide full toss outside off. Perera was making room and he fails to make contact
full and wide outside off, Perera clears his front foot out and throws his bat at that, he gets a toe-end to that and it goes high in the empty space at deep extra cover
he bowls a full toss wide outside off, Patel powers it down to long off for a single
now he walks to the off side and pulls the short of length delivery over short fine leg for a boundary
fuller length outside off, now Patel starts swinging. He makes room and tonks that over cover, it just clear the rope
full delivery on the pads, Perera aims for the stands but inside edges it towards midwicket. The fielders are all deep so they come back for a couple
he gets to his fifty with a neat flick to deep midwicket off a low full toss
another full toss on the pads, Praveen is lucky this time as Perera smacks it straight to the deep midwicket fielder
goes for a yorker, but this is a low full toss on the pads, all Perera has to do is to get some bat on it, and he does it well, flicking it to backward square leg boundary
bowls a yorker this time, just outside off and not much Perera can do about it.. He digs it out down the pitch
long on can watch as this is full and was asking to be hit, Perera gets under it slams it into the stands again
short of length delivery, Perera goes for a powerful pull to the leg side which is cut off by Sandeep at deep midwicket
length delivery outside off, Perera does what he does all the time, brings down the bat with awesome power and slaps it over long on .. way deep into the stands
short delivery on the stumps, Thisara sways out of line
stays on the back foot and tucks the length delivery towards deep midwicket for a single
back of length delivery outside off, the batsman dabs it towards point for a single
back of length delivery, pushed towards midwicket

oh no, this had been dropped by Mandeep! The batsman went after the full delivery, but didn't get hold of it at all, It went high up in the air towards mid off. Mandeep from extra cover ran towards it, the long off fielder ran towards it.. It was long off's (Praveen) catch and it was never going to be easy for Mandeep
slightly short outside off, the batsman rocks back and cuts it hard to deep point
tossed up delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and drives it in the gap at cow corner for a couple
bowls the top spinner on the stumps, Perera stays on the back foot and punches it down to long on
that was quick! 120 kph! The batsman does well to bring his bat down in time.. Shane Watson lost his wicket to that two days ago
tossed up delivery on the pads, the batsman plays a bit too early and gets hit on the pads, but that pitched outside the line of stumps
length delivery, again the extra pace hurries the batsman, it takes an inside edge down to fine leg boundary
short delivery outside off, Karan tries to do what he did to Harmeet, but Awana is much quicker. He tried to pull it, but gets a thick top edge that balloons for the keeper to take an easy catch.
length delivery angling across the batsman, the extra pace of Awana is causing some discomfort as the batsman stays rooted and pokes at it, gets beaten
short delivery, but this one is down the leg side.. The batsman ducks and looks at the umpire, he gets a surprise as the umpire says it was an ok delivery
fuller length delivery outside off and the batsman gets a thick outside edge past the keeper. All very very useful runs these
he bowls it short of length outside off, the batsman guides it to third man with an upper cut
and another good shot! No tap, dab about this one either! It is short and Karan swings his bat properly and pulls it almost all the way for a six down to deep backward square leg
he gives this one a proper thwack! It was a length ball and that met the bat coming down at a 100 miles an hour, it sails over the sight screen
it's a length ball outside off, and at Harmeet's pace, the batsman takes a chance of pulling it over the bowler's head.. Doesn't get it too far though as long on fields
weird shot! He was trying to pull one outside off and tying to take his bat away at the same time. Gets a thick edge down to third man
he starts walking down the pitch too early, the bowler bowls a shorter delivery outside off in response, the batsman sways out of line
fuller length delivery outside off, the batsman drives it firmly down to long off
this one is a proper legspinner, turns into the batsman who was stuck in the crease.. He chops it on to his pads
sweeps this one down to deep backward square leg

bowls this one quicker and shorter outside off, the batsman tries to cut it late, gets an edge, but Gilchrist is not able to hold on to that. It was of the face, big deviation there. Hard to take those ones
fuller delivery on the pads, the batsman sweeps it down to deep backward square
and again, Parthiv sweeps it from outside off down to deep backward square leg
pushed through outside off, the batsman sweeps it from there and towards deep square leg
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to mid on for a quick single
another good tight delivery on the stumps, it is pushed back down the pitch. Mid off comes round quickly to cut down the chance of a single
the batsman defends the back of length delivery off the back foot, straight down the pitch
he walks down the pitch and flicks the length delivery over mid-on, lot of wrist in that shot..
angles it in and bowls it short of length, the batsman tucks it to deep midwicket off the back foot
length delivery just outside off, the batsman pushes it to deep cover for a single
full and flighted on the stumps, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to deep midwicket for a single
pushes it wide this time and the batsman chops it past backward point for a couple of runs
tossed up and fuller, but it's on the pads, the batsman sweeps it down to fine leg
more air this time, the batsman comes forward and drives it down to long on
slower tossed up delivery, the batsman waits on the back foot and pushes it back to the bowler
waits on the back foot and opens the face to a slider outside off to guide it fine on the off side. They comeback for three
he stands tall on his toes and flicks the length delivery on his pads to deep midwicket
length delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and pushes it firmly back to the bowler
back of length delivery outside off, Karan pushes it back past the non striker for a quick single
tries a short delivery, but at his pace, it doesn't do much, just bounces over the ducking batsman. Another batsman would have slapped that out of the ground
back of length outside off, the batsman plays it from the crease, pushes it towards point
the hat-trick ball is back of length on the stumps, 126 kph, easily tucked towards midwicket for a single
fuller delivery, almost a yorker, Karan digs it out back to the bowler
this time it's a proper legspinner outside off, the batsman plants his front foot out and gets hit on the pads. Hit outside the line though

here comes the googly and Sammy had no clue about that! He played it off the back foot and to his horror, saw the ball turning into him. Too late sir, that hit him right in front of off, on the back pad
bowls the slider, the batsman defends it awkwardly off the back foot
pushed through on the leg stump line, hits the pads, but that was going down leg
tosses it up on off stump, the batsman pushes it towards wide mid on for a single

he is running through the side! Gets his third wicket of the night! He bowls length delivery just outside off, it doesn't do much and is bowled at a gentle pace. The batsman thrusted his front foot out and played outside the line, possibly for the movement, which wasn't there. A nothing delivery fetches Sandeep a wicket..

and now Sandeep Sharma gets a second one! This one was fuller length on the middle stump line, White had already planted his front foot out and he gets hit on the knee roll. The umpire raises his finger, but White is disappointed. Was there an inside edge on that? Will have to look at that again. The TV commentators are convinced it was out, but I think there might have been something on that
he bowls it just back of length and on the off stump line, Parthiv dabs it to the gap at cover for a single
he waits in the crease for a length delivery outside off, then defends it to point
length delivery on off stump, White comes forward and turns it towards midwicket with a roll of his wrist
back of length delivery on the pads, Patel fails to get any bat on that, it hits his thigh pad and rolls to the leg side
he misses out this time and is disappointed. It was short delivery down the leg side, White goes for the pull, but is a touch early into the shot, gets a bottom edge to the keeper
beautiful! It was a length delivery on the stumps and White plants his front foot out and drives it straight over the umpire's head
length delivery outside off, the batsman punches it off the front foot, straight to deep cover
he charges down the pitch and whacks the length delivery straight back to the bowler! This time, Harmeet was lucky as this one was really hit hard, it went past his turban...
fuller delivery outside off, the batsman pushes it to the left of mid off and takes a single
he was gone at the non-striker's end! Patel pushed it straight to point and ran straightaway, Miller had all the time.. but he missed. Parthiv apologises to White for that call
length delivery outside off, White comes forward and punches it to mid off
the batsman comes forward to one which is not that full, it bounces on to the handle of the bat, hit the batsman on his gloves
fuller length delivery outside off, the batsman leans on to it and just pushes it in the gap at extra cover.. Just a push, not full flourish of the bat
first wicket for Sandeep Sharma! He bowled this length delivery slightly wider, Vihari's eyes lit up, he went for a cut but slashed that straight into the hands of Miller at point
length delivery just outside off, Vihari comes forward and defends it to the off side
he bowls it full and wide outside off, some gentle swing for him, but that is too easy for his u-19 teammate to drive through extra cover
he comes forward to a length delivery and drives it on the off, but straight to short extra cover
he comes solidly behind the length delivery and pushes it to cover, but Pomersbach unnecessarily aims at the stumps and gives away an extra run
touch fuller this time, the batsman punches it back to the bowler
he is getting some movement off the pitch! It was a length delivery and Vihari tried to punch it without getting anywhere near the line, the ball leaves him at the last moment and beats the bat
he stays in the crease and defends the back of length delivery back down the pitch

he gets a wicket first ball! Dhawan comes forward to the length delivery on the stumps, just punches it back to the bowler, who bends down low on his follow through and grabs on to the opportunity. Big wicket this one. That one didn't really come off the middle of the bat
back of length delivery just outside off, this time Parthiv gets right behind it as he punches it hard through the gap at cover.. Another teaser for the fielder
now this one flies past the outside edge as the batsman has a poke at an angled delivery
he keeps it tight around off and middle line, much quicker that Praveen Kumar. Patel defends it off the back foot
he waits on the back foot and defends the back of length delivery towards off
back of length delivery, he tries to push it towards point but gets a thick outside edge that goes past the outstretched hand of the man at second slip
comes down the pitch to a back of length delivery and misses it. It went between the bat and the pad, stayed a touch low and the keeper went up in an appeal. Wasn't very far from the off stump either
back of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman waits for it in the crease, pushes it to mid off with soft hands and calls for a quick single
lunges forward and pushes the length delivery straight to mid on
the batsman waits for the ball to come to him, it was on his pads and came a touch slow, but he punches it extremely well through midwicket. It teases the fielder all the way to the boundary
the batsman comes forward to a length delivery outside off, defends it to cover
he now bowls a length delivery down the leg side

this one drops in the no man's land, between second slip and third man! Dhawan charged down at a back of length delivery, tried to pull it to leg side, but got a thick edge that ballooned over the slip fielder
length delivery on off, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to cover
beats the bat with one that angles across the batsman, Patel tentatively pushes at it from the crease and plays inside the line
length delivery on off, the batsman pushes it to cover

slashes at a short of length delivery and gets a thick outside edge. Praveen, at third man, lines himself up, but ends up just pushing it over the boundary. Should go as a drop, it wasn't as hard as Praveen made it look
short of length delivery, but on the leg stump line. The batsman swivels and pulls it down to fine leg
back of length and angling away from the batsman, but Dhawan, the kind of form he is in, just punches it through the gap at point..
takes a step forward and punches the length delivery straight to cover, he played it on the up
another one that straightens into the left hander, defended off the front foot
brings this one in to the lef-hander! It hits the pad first, then the bat, the bowler appeals. Not a bad appeal at all, but the umpire reckons it hit the bat first.. It was out for me
another length delivery, but this time it is outside off. The batsman tries to punch it off the back foot, but chops it towards point. Cheeky single taken, could have been close
it pitches outside leg stump and swings in towards middle and off, the batsman drops it to the leg side for a single
he takes a couple of steps down the pitch and taps that to wide mid-on, takes a single
length delivery, not very quick, but it moves away from the batsman, left alone
slower and full, the batsman only manages to hit it back to the bowler
full delivery on the stumps, the batsman punches it down the ground to long off
caught at wide long on! Another wicket for Sammy as Awana gets too much under this slower delivery and sends this soaring in the night sky, but Ishant has all the time to get under it
a quicker full delivery outside off, the batsman digs it out to long on for a single
LP gets a six! It was a slower delivery, the batsman whacks it hard and doesn't get hold of it, still manages to beat long off, just though
another run out! LP slapped it very hard, back to the bowler,  who gets a hand to it, and palms it to long off. The batsmen run for a second run which wasn't there
he gets a quick back of length delivery, which hits the middle of the bat as he dabs it towards point off the back foot
slower delivery this time, the batsman drags it to deep midwicket for a single
another swing and a miss as the batsman makes room, but swings down the wrong line
wasn't that out! It was full and fast and flicked something in its way to the keeper. It hits the stumps - the leg stump - and nothing moved.. How many times has it happened this year?
bowls another quick length ball on the stumps, Harmeet moves outside leg and slices it over backward point

this is sorry now. Steyn bowls a quick length delivery, 148 kph, Praveen tries to play it off the back foot, misses and looses his leg stump. Steyn doesn't celebrate, he quietly walks up and fixes the stumps

slower delivery, he is dropped again. This time it is Vihari. LP charged down the pitch, but got a thick leading edge over point, the fielder ran backward, got his hands to it, but wasn't able to hold on to the ball
short of length delivery outside off, the batsman pushes it to deep cover off the back foot
fuller delivery on the stumps, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler
the batsman moves outside off to whip a length delivery on the pads, but misses again as it goes very close past the leg stump. The keeper doesn't collect cleanly, allowing an extra
caught at midwicket! the batsman tries to whip a slower delivery on the pads down to fine leg, but gets a leading edge for Dhawan at midwicket to take a dolly
bowls a full and fast yorker outside off, the batsman drives it straight to extra cover
slower delivery on a length outside off, the batsman tries to launch it back down the ground, misses it completely

fuller and slower, the batsman punches it straight past the non-striker. The batsman tries to get back after Pomersbach calls him for a couple, but Perera's throw is flat at the striker's end. Patel whips off the bails and Sathish is gone
slower delivery on the leg stump line, the batsman clears his front foot out, but drags the ball to deep midwicket without timing
back of the length delivery on the stumps, Sathish tries to whip it over short fine by moving across, but gets hit on the body. They steal a single though
bowls a slower delivery, the batsman slaps it to long on without any timing
length delivery outside off, the batsman stays on the back foot and punches it to deep point
he moves outside leg and slaps a short of length delivery to deep midwicket
and Pomersbach is beaten again by the slower delivery. He charged down the pitch but played too early
he bowls a slower delivery full on the stumps, the batsman tries to smack it down the ground, but gets an outside edge to short third man
bowls a full yorker wide outside off, the batsman doesn't even get a touch on that

he had dropped it! How in the world! Oh my god! The batsman tried to slap a short of length delivery, he gets a top edge that was going straight down point's throat, but he doesn't even get a hand to that. .Karan Sharma there
he bowls an excellent offcutter that the batsman has no idea about! It pitches outside leg on a short of length, then turns a bit and beats the bat
back of length delivery outside off, the batsman chops it down to third man for a single
he goes full outside off this time, but the batsman drives it firmly down the ground. Long on cuts the boundary off
makes room by moving down leg, Steyn follows him with a back of length delivery. The batsman tries to pull it, but is beaten
quicker short of length delivery, but this is down the leg side
he charges down the wicket, but the bowler bowls a slower delivery, it just bounces over the stumps after it had missed the batsman's attempted slog
back of length delivery on the off stump, the batsman defends it off the back foot
bowls a quick back of length delivery that angles across the batsman, he is beaten as he tries to chop it to the off side
another one, this time the batsman makes room and slaps it hard to deep extra cover for a single
he bowls a googly that drifts away from the left-hander, who left it alone
this one is slower, turns away outside off, the batsman punches it hard to deep extra cover
this one was shorter and quicker, turning away, he cuts it hard and threads the gap at backward point for a boundary
a full toss follows, Sathish goes down on one knee and slaps it over midwicket again..Huge hit
oh is that the floodgate opener! It was a length ball and he gives it a mighty thwack over midwicket
he makes room and guides the back of the length delivery fine on the off side, very close to the keeper
another slower delivery! The batsman is too early on the pull and is beaten, the ball bounces short of the keeper, who is unable to get behind it and it runs to the boundary
he bowls a slower offcutter this time, the batsman waits and pushes it back to the bowler
he bowls a slower legcutter outside off, the batsman waits and cuts it hard to deep cover
length delivery outside off, the batsman punches it straight to cover
short of length delivery outside off, seams away a touch, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler
on the stumps this time, the batsman waits and pushes it back to the bowler
bowls a googly outside off, it turns further away, the batsman pushes it to cover off the back foot
slower delivery outside off, the batsman opens the face to run it down to third man for a single
he tries to turn a quicker delivery to the leg side, but gets a leading edge back down the pitch
tossed up delivery, it turns big time too, the batsman cuts it straight to cover point
pushes it through on the stumps, the batsman punches it to wide long on for a single
he goes for a reverse paddle and hits it between the keeper's legs for a couple. Vihari from first slip pulls the ball back
this time he bowls a tossed up one from wide of the crease and beats the bat as the batsman plays inside the line

tossed up delivery outside off, the batsman goes for a sweep, but misses it. Parthiv Patel takes the bails off and starts appealing immediately.. But the batsman is safe as he slid his foot back just in time
quicker and shorter, down the leg side, the batsman pulls it down to fine leg for a single
tossed up fuller and it drifts on towards the pads, the batsman comes forward and chips it over midwicket for a couple
tossed up delivery on the stumps, the batsman defends it off the front foot
he bowls a slower delivery that is tapped past point, the batsmen get back for a couple
back of length delivery on the pads, the batsman pulls it down to fine leg
Sammy gets another one! This is the big one! Miller gets a length delivery outside off, he tries to drive it without moving his feet, doesn't get any timing and he hits it straight to cover
he bowls a slower delivery this time, the batsman waits for it and is only able to push it to point
length delivery outside off, the batsman tries to push it to off from the crease, but gets an inside edge to the keeper
he bowls it back of length on the stumps, the batsman dabs it straight to point off the back foot
fuller delivery on the stumps, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler
slightly shorter and flatter, the batsman wait and opens the face to play it to short third man
comes forward this time and defends it solidly back to the bowler
he stays in the crease and pushes that to the fielder at cover
he bowls a slow flighted delivery, the batsman gets an inside edge that drops close to the stumps
tossed up delivery outside off, it is driven in the air back towards the bowler, but falls well short
fuller length delivery on off stump, the batsman pushes it to cover off the front foot
bowls back of length wide outside off, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler off the back foot
bowls a back of length delivery outside off, the batsman punches it off the back foot to deep point
that was not very far from the short cover fielder! It was full and Miller drove it in the air, but that was hit really hard

and he gets a second wicket! The Gangnam starts, the pacifier is out too. He bowls a length delivery outside off, Gilly tries to pull it again. It wasn't that short and the batsman gets a thick inside edge on to his stumps

he strikes first ball! It was a short of length delivery outside off, the batsman goes back to pull it, but ends up getting a toe-end down the ground where the fielder running in from long on takes a good low catch
tossed up delivery on the stumps, the batsman drives it to deep midwicket
he comes forward and drives it hard to long off for a single
is that a stumping missed! Yes, Parthiv was not able to take this one fired down the leg side.. Gilchrist had fallen offbalance
he pushes the batsman back with a quicker one, Gilly gets an inside edge on to his pads
he waits on the back foot and punches it straight to cover
quicker and flatter outside off, the batsman punches it to deep cover off the back foot
he pushes it through on the off stump, the batsman defends it to off
this time he does it Gilly style. It was a fuller delivery wide outside off, he doesn't come forward, rather waits on the back foot and crunches it through cover with a quick swish of the bat
pushes it fuller outside off, the batsman is slow to come forward, drives it without much timing to cover
on the pads again, the batsman goes on the back foot and whips it to deep midwicket. The fielder is a touch slow and the batsmen get back for a second
back of length delivery on the pads, the batsman stands tall on his toes and punches it to deep midwicket
he makes room by moving outside leg and slaps a totally alright length delivery through backward point
bowls a short of length delivery on the stumps, Gilchrist tries to pull it, but gets hit on the thigh pad
back of length delivery outside off, doesn't bounce as high as Gilly expected it to as he went for the pull. It  hits the toe-end and takes a chunk of wood out of his bat
length delivery on off stump, the batsman pushes it softly to mid off and takes another quick single
back of length delivery again, this time it is on the pads and the batsman flicks it fine, but straight to Ishant at short fine leg
he bowls a back of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman defends it to the left of the bowler
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman waits in the crease and pushes it to the left of mid on for a single
he bowls it full outside off and Gilchrist says thank you, he drives it hard through extra cover
length delivery just outside off, Marsh comes forward and then leaves it alone
he moves outside leg stump to give himself some room, the bowler follows him with a short of length delivery, the batsman arches back and then guides it to third man for a single
that was quick and menacing delivery outside off. It pitched on length and jagged away from the batsman late, beats the outside edge
short of length delivery on off stump, the batsman pushes it to the off side off the back foot

just out of reach of the bowler! Oh no and it has run away to the after mid on and mid off comically run into each other and allow the ball to go through! It was a length delivery and the batsman got a leading edge it just to the right of the bowler
beats the bat with a pacy length delivery outside off. Gilchrist wanted to punch it through covers but he played inside the line
short of length delivery and there was not much room in that one, but Marsh arches slightly backward and cuts it over point for a boundary
now Gilchrist does exactly the same thing, pushes it to mid off and calls for a quick single
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman pushes it with soft hands towards mid-off, calls for a quick single
bowls a length delivery on leg stump line, it hits the batsman's pads, but that pitched outside leg
length delivery, closer to the stumps this time, the batsman lets it go through
length delivery but very wide outside off, the batsman latches on to it and punches it hard through cover point off the back foot
length ball on off stump, he drives it hard again, but the bowler gets a hand to it and deflects it to mid on
fuller delivery on off stump and Marsh plays his first proper shot and it's a beautiful one! Straight drive down the ground for four
this one goes past the inside edge as Marsh tries to cut a not-so-short delivery. There was no room there as well and the ball straightened a touch
fuller length ball outside off, Marsh tries to drive it without going forward, but gets an inside edge on to his pads.. That rolls past the off stump
back of length delivery just outside off, good bounce and carry on that, Marsh leaves it alone
bowls a fuller length delivery wide outside off, angling away from the left-hander. Marsh lets it go through
he bowls it full and wide, Marsh tries to drive it from the crease and gets a thick outside edge to third man

caught at cover! This is what Steyn does all the time! He bowls it full around the middle and leg line, but then it swings away from there. Mandeep was looking to tuck it to the leg side, but he gets a leading edge towards off where White takes a good low diving catch
bowls a full delivery down the leg side while there are two slips in place, the ball flicks the pads and Patel does well to stop that one
short of length delivery on off stump, Gilchrist punches it off the back foot to wide mid off for a single
beats the bat as Gilchrist plays for the swing, but it goes straight on
length delivery outside off, swings in to the batsman, who pushes it to mid on
